## DE analysis; protein-coding using all protein_cdoing genes as size factors; 
## sncRNA (w/o tRNAs) using all sncRNAs as size factors
## This section is stored in "IBC.image"
```{r, echo=FALSE}
dat<-read.delim("all_IBC_cleanedup.counts")
coldata <- data.frame(c(rep("Healthy",4),rep("FBC",4),rep("BC",4),rep("IBC",10),
                        rep(c(rep("Healthy",16),rep("BC",6),rep("IBC",10)),2)),
                      c(rep("H",4),rep("B",4),
                        rep(c("BCN","BCP"),2),
                        c("IBCP","IBCN","IBCN",rep("IBCP",6),"IBCN"),
                        rep("H",16),
                        c("BCN","BCP","BCP","BCN","BCN","BCP"),
                        c("IBCP","IBCN","IBCN",rep("IBCP",6),"IBCN"),
                        rep("H",16),
                        c("BCN","BCP","BCP","BCN","BCN","BCP"),
                        c("IBCP","IBCN","IBCN",rep("IBCP",6),"IBCN")),
                      c(rep("ForzenTissue",8),rep("FFPE",14),rep("PBMC",32),rep("Plasma",32)),
                      colnames(dat)[2:87],
                      row.names=colnames(dat)[2:87])
colnames(coldata) <- c("Disease","HR","Tissue","Name")

#mRNA DE
pro_dat<-dat[dat$Type=="Protein coding",]
FFPE_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,2:23],
                                   colData = coldata[1:22,],design = ~Disease)
PBMC_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,24:55],
                                   colData = coldata[23:54,],design = ~Disease)
Plasma_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,56:87],
                                     colData = coldata[55:86,],design = ~Disease)
FFPE_dds <- DESeq(FFPE_dds,parallel = T)
PBMC_dds <- DESeq(PBMC_dds,parallel = T)
Plasma_dds <- DESeq(Plasma_dds,parallel = T)
FFPE_BC_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,10:13],
                                   colData = coldata[9:12,],design = ~HR)
FFPE_IBC_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,14:23],
                                   colData = coldata[13:22,],design = ~HR)
PBMC_BC_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,40:45],
                                   colData = coldata[39:44,],design = ~HR)
PBMC_IBC_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,46:55],
                                   colData = coldata[45:54,],design = ~HR)
Plasma_BC_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,72:77],
                                   colData = coldata[71:76,],design = ~HR)
Plasma_IBC_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,78:87],
                                   colData = coldata[77:86,],design = ~HR)
sizeFactors(FFPE_BC_HR) <- sizeFactors(FFPE_dds)[9:12]
sizeFactors(FFPE_IBC_HR) <- sizeFactors(FFPE_dds)[13:22]
sizeFactors(PBMC_BC_HR) <- sizeFactors(PBMC_dds)[17:22]
sizeFactors(PBMC_IBC_HR) <- sizeFactors(PBMC_dds)[23:32]
sizeFactors(Plasma_BC_HR) <- sizeFactors(Plasma_dds)[17:22]
sizeFactors(Plasma_IBC_HR) <- sizeFactors(Plasma_dds)[23:32]
FFPE_BC_HR <- DESeq(FFPE_BC_HR,parallel = T)
FFPE_IBC_HR <- DESeq(FFPE_IBC_HR,parallel = T)
PBMC_BC_HR <- DESeq(PBMC_BC_HR,parallel = T)
PBMC_IBC_HR <- DESeq(PBMC_IBC_HR,parallel = T)
Plasma_BC_HR <- DESeq(Plasma_BC_HR,parallel = T)
Plasma_IBC_HR <- DESeq(Plasma_IBC_HR,parallel = T)
#sncRNA DE
snc_dat<-dat[dat$Type=="sncRNA"|dat$Type=="miRNA",]
snc_dat$Type2<-droplevels(snc_dat$Type2)
FFPE_snc_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,2:23], 
                                       colData = coldata[1:22,],design = ~Disease)
PBMC_snc_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,24:55], 
                                       colData = coldata[23:54,],design = ~Disease)
Plasma_snc_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,56:87], 
                                         colData = coldata[55:86,],design = ~Disease)
FFPE_snc_dds <- DESeq(FFPE_snc_dds,parallel = T)
PBMC_snc_dds <- DESeq(PBMC_snc_dds,parallel = T)
Plasma_snc_dds <- DESeq(Plasma_snc_dds,parallel = T)
FFPE_BC_snc_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,10:13],
                                     colData = coldata[9:12,],design = ~HR)
FFPE_IBC_snc_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,14:23],
                                      colData = coldata[13:22,],design = ~HR)
PBMC_BC_snc_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,40:45],
                                     colData = coldata[39:44,],design = ~HR)
PBMC_IBC_snc_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,46:55],
                                      colData = coldata[45:54,],design = ~HR)
Plasma_BC_snc_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,72:77],
                                       colData = coldata[71:76,],design = ~HR)
Plasma_IBC_snc_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,78:87],
                                        colData = coldata[77:86,],design = ~HR)
sizeFactors(FFPE_BC_snc_HR) <- sizeFactors(FFPE_snc_dds)[9:12]
sizeFactors(FFPE_IBC_snc_HR) <- sizeFactors(FFPE_snc_dds)[13:22]
sizeFactors(PBMC_BC_snc_HR) <- sizeFactors(PBMC_snc_dds)[17:22]
sizeFactors(PBMC_IBC_snc_HR) <- sizeFactors(PBMC_snc_dds)[23:32]
sizeFactors(Plasma_BC_snc_HR) <- sizeFactors(Plasma_snc_dds)[17:22]
sizeFactors(Plasma_IBC_snc_HR) <- sizeFactors(Plasma_snc_dds)[23:32]
FFPE_BC_snc_HR <- DESeq(FFPE_BC_snc_HR,parallel = T)
FFPE_IBC_snc_HR <- DESeq(FFPE_IBC_snc_HR,parallel = T)
PBMC_BC_snc_HR <- DESeq(PBMC_BC_snc_HR,parallel = T)
PBMC_IBC_snc_HR <- DESeq(PBMC_IBC_snc_HR,parallel = T)
Plasma_BC_snc_HR <- DESeq(Plasma_BC_snc_HR,parallel = T)
Plasma_IBC_snc_HR <- DESeq(Plasma_IBC_snc_HR,parallel = T)

#function for volcano plot
plot_volcano<-function(dat_non_sig,dat_sig,x_lim,y_lim,xlab_seq,
                       ylab_seq,title,type,leg_posx,leg_posy){
  plot(dat_non_sig$log2FoldChange, -log10(dat_non_sig$padj),xlim=x_lim,ylim=y_lim,
       main=title, xlab=bquote(log[2](FC)),xaxt="n",bty="n", yaxt="n",
       ylab=bquote("-"*log[10]*"(adjusted p-value)"),col=mcol[1],
       pch=20, cex=0.7)
  axis(side = 1,at = xlab_seq,labels = xlab_seq)
  axis(side = 2,labels = ylab_seq,at = ylab_seq,las=1)
  abline(v=0, col="black", lty=3, lwd=1.0)
  abline(v=-2, col="black", lty=4, lwd=2.0)
  abline(v=2, col="black", lty=4, lwd=2.0)
  abline(h=-log10(0.001), col="black", lty=3, lwd=2.0)
  if (type=="pro"){
    points(dat_sig$log2FoldChange,-log10(dat_sig$padj), pch=20, col=mcol[2], cex=0.7)
    legend(leg_posx,leg_posy,pch=20,bty="n",col=c(mcol,"white"),
           legend =c("Non-significant",as.expression(bquote("|"*log[2]*"(FC)|">=2)),
                     as.expression(bquote(padj<=0.001))),cex=0.7)
  } else if (type=="snc") {
    points(dat_sig$log2FoldChange,-log10(dat_sig$padj), pch=21, 
           bg=scol[dat_sig$Type2], cex=0.7,lwd=0.5)
    legend(leg_posx,leg_posy,pch=21,bty="n",pt.bg=c(mcol[1],scol),cex=0.7,pt.lwd = 0.5,
           legend =c("Non-significant",levels(dat_sig$Type2)))
  }
}
mcol<-c("black","red")
scol<-brewer.pal(9, "Set1")
pcol<-brewer.pal(4,"Paired")
save.image("IBC.image")
```
## plot the volano for pair-wise comparason
```{r, echo=FALSE}
pdf("IBC_volcano.pdf",height=6,width=15,onefile = T)
#postscript("IBC_volcano.eps",onefile = T, paper="US)
par(mfrow=c(1,3))
#Forzen BC vs Healthy
res<-data.frame(results(FFPE_dds,contrast = c("Disease","FBC","Healthy"),alpha = 0.05))
res<-cbind(res,pro_dat[,c(1,89)])
res<-res[complete.cases(res),]
res$log10padj<-log10(1/res$padj)
non_sig<-subset(res, padj>0.001 | abs(log2FoldChange)<2)
sig<-subset(res, padj<=0.001 & abs(log2FoldChange)>=2)
plot_volcano(non_sig,sig,c(-20,20),c(0,20),seq(-20,20,5),seq(0,20,5),
             "mRNA (Forzen tissue: nonBC vs Healthy)","pro",-20,20)
sig_list<-c(16 , 26 , 29,  58, 137 ,145 ,157, 164)
text(sig[sig_list,c(2,9)],pos=3,offset=0.15,labels = sig[sig_list,7],cex=0.7)
sig_list<-c(21,22,92,129)
text(sig[sig_list,c(2,9)],pos=2,offset=0.15,labels = sig[sig_list,7],cex=0.7)
sig_list<-c(62,126,170)
text(sig[sig_list,c(2,9)],pos=4,offset=0.15,labels = sig[sig_list,7],cex=0.7)
```
